MIND. [1] [Form.]
Want of memory ; forgetful in evening.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Form.]
Vertigo ; all things seem to move to and fro, and reeling of body.
Dulness of head ; pressure on both sides between temples and ears.
In all kinds of apoplectic diseases.
Strengthens the brain.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Form.]
Headache in left forepart of head and temple back to occiput, beginning earlier every day, with a sore pain over eye, increasing gradually, with cutting, extending into ear.
Headache with cracking in left ear, followed by pain in left temple, then in vertex, with nausea, and abatement of pain in forehead.
Sick headache, with shooting, neuralgic pains in temples.
Nervous headache.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Form.]
Itching of scalp and head.
Hair on head ceased falling out when combing.
Contusions of head.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Form.]
Dimness of sight.
Nebula ; leucoma ; pterygium.
Maculæ and ulcers on cornea.
Rheumatic inflammation of eyes and sequela.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Form.]
Ringing, buzzing in ears.
Cracking in left ear, with headache.
Difficult hearing ; deafness.
Earache in both ears, morning getting up.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Form.]
Catarrh.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Form.]
Grumbling in teeth during afternoon, from draught.
Pain in decayed last molar, left side.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Form.]
Sore throat in morning with much mucus.
Sore throat < left side.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Form.]
Nausea and vomiting.
Nausea with headache, and vomiting of yellowish, bitter mucus.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Form.]
Constant pressure at cardiac end of stomach, and a burning pain there.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Form.]
Flatulency.
Hardening of mesenteric glands.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Form.]
Diarrhœa after meals, or only during day, not at night, or day and night, or before midnight.
Diarrhœa, with tenesmus ; pain in bowels before stool.
Diarrhœa of children.
White stools.
Constipation and sensation of constriction of sphincter ani.
Tapeworm.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Form.]
Seminal emissions.
Weakness of sexual organs.
Scanty ejaculation with incomplete erection.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Form.]
Uterine complaints.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Form.]
Lack of milk with nursing women.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Form.]
Hoarseness with sore throat.
Small piece of phlegm in larynx which cannot be brought up by coughing.
   

COUGH. [27] [Form.]
Tedious and long lasting ; < at night and from motion ; with an aching in forehead and a constrictive pain in chest.
Violent attacks of cough with vomiting, day and night.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Form.]
Pleuritic pains.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Form.]
Violent penetrating itching at right nipple.
Violent prickling, pressing stitches in region of left nipple ; later on left side of back, but more violent ; still later, the same sensation on other parts of body.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Form.]
Violent itching on left shoulder-blade.
Pain in back.
Affection of spinal cord.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Form.]
Itching in armpits in morning.
Severe pain above right elbow.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Form.]
Gout ; gouty pain in limbs.
Arthritis vaga.
Chronic gout and stiffness of joints.
Old atonic gout.
Checked foot-sweat. θ Chorea.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Form.]
Rheumatism appearing suddenly, mostly in joints, with restlessness ; patients desire motion, although it makes pain more acute ; pains > by pressure ; sweat without relief ; right side principally and more severely affected than left.
Old local or general rheumatic affections ; internal or external.
Rheumatic or gouty pains.
Stiffness and contraction of joints.
   

NERVES. [36] [Form.]
Great lassitude and prostration.
Faintings.
Limbs lame ; paralyzed.
Paralysis.
Spasms.
A long, horribly maltreated chorea lessened as soon as the foot-sweat, which had been checked, was brought on again by putting feet in a bag with living ants and creating steam with hot stones.
Epilepsy.
Affections of the spinal cord.
Strengthens the nerves.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Form.]
Wakes up early and feels that she has had sufficient sleep.
When awaking in morning : headache ; vomiting, with headache ; pain in eyes ; stitches in ear.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Form.]
Great liability to take cold.
Consequences of cold and wet ; cold bathing ; damp weather.
   

FEVER. [40] [Form.]
Sweat without relief.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Form.]
Pains left then right ; right then left.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Form.]
Cutting pain : in head ; into ear.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Form.]
Nodes around joints, internally and externally.
Watery swellings ; dropsy ; cachexies.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Form.]
Contusions ; dislocations.
Atrophy after wounds.
Complaints from overlifting.
